name: book_new_patient
description: Register a new patient and book one of the times returned by find_slots, in one step. Use only after find_patient did not verify the caller and they say they are new to the practice. Collect first and last name, date of birth, an email address (spell it back) and a phone number if different from the one they are calling from; ask for sex (male, female or other) when the result says the practice's system needs it. Read the time back and get a clear yes before calling. Report the result exactly as returned; if new patients can't be registered here, offer leave_message.

phone_number.description: Ten-digit phone number. Leave out to use the number the caller is calling from.

gender.description: Only when the caller gives it, or the practice's system needs it.

slot_id.description: A slot_id returned by find_slots on this call.
